= 20t + 20 mV

at t = 5

en.content: A swimmer wants to cross a river from point A to point B. Line AB makes an angle of 30 with the flow of river. Magnitude of velocity of the swimmer is same as that of the river. The angle with the line AB should be _________, so that the swimmer reaches point B.
en.explanation:
Both velocity vectors are of same magnitude therefore resultant would pass exactly midway through them

= 30
